R6I-grouse-drive-0003.name: 300 m SE of Little Oliver Creek
R6I-grouse-drive-0003.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R6I-grouse-drive-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Little Oliver M/L (gravel road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
10 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from City of Terrace, about 57 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beam Station Rd, Queensway Dr, Hwy 16 and 37.
Park: 54.80267, -128.26615, pull off on Little Oliver M/L (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the unnamed road stretch, 3.9 km one way. About 77 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-9, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
